query.q: trimmed case-insensitive literal text; NUL forbidden
query.cursor: optional opaque continuation bound to owner and normalized query

result.items: bounded array of id, matchField (title|id|content|thinking|originalContent|translatedContent), matchSnippet, matchRole (user|assistant|null), conversation (metadata only)
result.nextCursor: string|null; may be present on an empty partial page
result.coverageReasons: bounded non-sensitive reason codes; no source ids or transcript text

storage.pageResult: items [{id,snippet,role,match_field}], next_cursor, incomplete; projection health added at runtime boundary
storage.legacyResult: items array for callers without page=true
storage.ownership: required positive user_id, applied before candidates, joins, limits and metadata hydration
storage.order: phrase/title/id matches first, then all-whitespace-terms matches; updated_at_ms DESC,id DESC within each phase

tables.sqliteFts: storage_search_chunks_fts: optional FTS5 trigram index on folded_text, external content storage_search_chunks, content_rowid=rowid; queries must still verify owner

indexing.bounds: independent background maintenance; bounded source pages and total projection disk budget; oversized or unsupported sources remain explicitly partial, never silently complete
indexing.largeDocuments: extract searchable fields without hydrating tool payloads where possible; bounded archives may be indexed message-by-message; never unbounded foreground transcript reads
indexing.lifecycle: dirty markers remain transactional and exact-token acknowledged; disposable format upgrade restarts background backfill; foreground authority writes do not extract text
indexing.query: SQLite trigram fast path has a VM-step ceiling; if exhausted resume portable scan, bounded by headers and chunks with intra-conversation cursors, preserving phrase and cross-turn word matches; never silently truncate or repeat an unfinishable fast path

browser.authority: valid server hits render independently of preloaded local catalog; metadata is batched by the server, no per-hit transcript requests
browser.requests: one in-flight request, cancellation and sequence fencing on all outcomes; debounced input; no per-render network request
browser.failures: failed search is distinct from successful zero hits; preserve results with visible retry; do not silently substitute local-only history
browser.pagination: explicit load more, including empty pages with continuation; bound retained rows and automatic continuation
browser.refresh: reconcile local metadata without requery floods; bounded refresh on relevant invalidation and explicit retry; teardown aborts work
